Name CrestP-Sat (CrestP-Sat1)
Spacecraft type CubeSat
Units or mass 1U
Status not launched, expected in 2026
Launcher Falcon 9
Organisation Crest Astra
Institution Company
Entity Commercial
Headquarters Japan
Launch brokerer Space BD
Partners Aich University of Technology
Oneliner

Test satellite-to-ground Visible light communication (VLC).
Description

LED payload meant to generate light that is visible from Earth, and to test satellite-to-ground Visible light communication (VLC). The satellite will also test ground-to-satellite radio wave communication and provide payload space for other organizations to test their technologies.
